notes: The page shows steps 1-6 together; the parts list is not a building step.
Step 2: the 2x6 plate sits on the 4x4 plate and leaves one stud row free on each long side.
Step 3: the two wheel holders are attached underneath the ends of the 2x6 plate. They are listed with rests_on [] because nothing is under them, and their joins are in other_joins.
Wheels and tyres are not placed on this page.
Step 4: the two red 1x4 plates go on the exposed rows of the 4x4. The trans-red 1x2 goes on the right wheel holder.
Step 5: the three white curved bricks and the trans-brown panel (windscreen) are placed at the front. The exact supports are estimated from the picture.
Step 6: the white 2x4 plate goes on the rear. The third red 1x4 sticks out at the front-left; its support (b3) is my best guess.
Step 7: the trans-red 1x2 goes on the rear of the white 2x4. The two trans-clear 1x1 plates are already on the front red plate in the step 7 picture, with no arrows, so I added them in step 7 on b13.

Step 8: two red jumpers and two clip plates fill the rest of the white 2x4. Step 9: the two red wheel arches go on at the front and a third jumper goes on top; its supports are my best guess from the picture.
Step 10: the white 1x4 tile on the back is the spoiler. Step 11: the glow bars snap into the clips. Step 12: the four wheels go on the holder pins and each tyre goes on its wheel.

The white curved bricks on page 1 are all three of that part. Step 10 seems to show one at the rear, so I may have put all three at the front. This could not be fixed here, because it affects earlier pages.
Supports for the arches, the jumper and the tile are estimated.
